_comment: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers the CLIENT may expose as tools.
Copy this file to mcp_servers.json and edit it - mcp_servers.json is seeded from
this template at startup if missing and is NEVER overwritten.
NOTHING IS ENABLED BY DEFAULT. An MCP server is an external process or a remote
endpoint the AI can drive, so 'enabled' is a human decision made in this file, and
the first use still asks a consent card (stdio -> subprocess consent, http -> url consent).
name        tool-name namespace: tools appear as mcp__<name>__<tool>. Letters/digits/_/.-
enabled     false = never started, never in the schema.
transport   'stdio' (command + args on this machine) or 'http' (url).
env         extra environment variables (merged over the process env).
cwd         working directory for the server process (optional).
roles       which CLIENT roles may use this server. '*' = any. An unknown role adds nothing.
